name: Video Embed Ted
description: Adds a TED talks provider to Video Embed Field.
project_description:
This module provides Ted handler for Video Embed Field module. Module also can get thumbnail image.

 Requirements 
 Video Embed Field 

 Usage 
 To add video you can use TED.com standard web page address for video, for example https://www.ted.com/talks/tony_robbins_asks_why_we_do_what_we_do
